create_TopdownAffine_transform: create a TopdownAffine transform to crop and resize a bbox region to a fixed input size
use_TopdownAffine_with_udp: use TopdownAffine with unbiased data processing by setting use_udp to True
transform_keypoints_with_affine: transform keypoints coordinates using the TopdownAffine warp matrix during image affine transform
fix_aspect_ratio_bbox: use the _fix_aspect_ratio static method to reshape bbox scales to a fixed w/h aspect ratio
review_TopdownAffine_transform: review the TopdownAffine class and its transform method for single instance bbox cropping and warping
